C1819.title: DJI Romo Robot Vacuum Backend Privilege Escalation 7000 Devices Controlled
C1819.summary: The DJI Romo robot vacuum backend authorization issue was reportedly discovered in late January 2026 and publicly explained in March 2026. DJI said an internal review first found the issue, after which a researcher reported it through the bug bounty program, and the fix was completed. The issue involves risks in smart home backend authorization checks, device binding relationships, and remote control paths such as MQTT; if the control plane has authorization bypasses, attackers may view device state, operate devices, or access home environment information. Details such as Sammy Azdoufal, 7,000/6,700 devices, 24 countries, 100,000 MQTT messages, a 30,000 dollar bounty, and The Verge reporting should be supported with verifiable sources if included.
